scope: Current public, owned, nonfork, unarchived repositories; profile excluded.

methodology.languages: Extension-classified source bytes, deduplicated globally by Git blob SHA; excludes notebooks, markup/stylesheets, data, reports, archives, vendor, dependencies and build output. Repository content is not an authorship or proficiency score.
methodology.libraries: One evidence match per repository from runtime dependencies or implementation imports. Long environment freezes need corroborating imports. Bounded sample: up to six manifests and twelve prioritised source files per repository; initial capture may contain additional source verification.
methodology.agentic: One implementation-symbol or executable configuration match per repository and category, only in agent/RAG/Rufus repositories. README prose, tests and documentation are excluded. Source evidence establishes implementation presence, not operational reliability or production use.
methodology.visual: Doughnut slices divide the category evidence total. Right-side bars are relative to the largest item in that group. No proficiency scores, percentages or counts are printed.
